senses.definition: (uncountable) The process of childbearing; the beginning of life; the emergence of a human baby or other viviparous animal offspring from the mother's body into the environment.

examples: Intersex babies account for roughly one per cent of all births.

quotes.text: In Greece a child was given its name on the seventh or tenth day after birth.

senses.definition: (countable) A beginning or start; a point of origin.
(uncountable) The circumstances of one's background, ancestry, or upbringing.
examples: He was of noble birth, but fortune had not favored him.

senses.definition: A familial relationship established by childbirth.
examples: Her birth father left when she was a baby; she was raised by her mother and stepfather.

senses.definition: (transitive) To bear or give birth to (a child).
